newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open 0.10 cent higher.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open 0.10 cent higher.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open 0.10 cent firmer Wednesday, based on market orders at 1020 EDT, traders said.
NYCE's weekly spec/hedge report showed speculators holding a hefty 52.1 percent net short position as of April 11.
Traders had expected a smaller net short position but said the increase in open interest coupled with options expiry last week, make the effect of today's report difficult to predict.
Tuesday, spot May finished 0.60 cent lower at 71.76 cents a lb, traded 72.50 to 71.10 cents, with July down 0.64 cent at 73.40 cents.
Support in May was seen at the contract low of 70.90 and then at 70.00 cents. Traders pegged the upside target at 73.00 cents.
((-- S Rostler, New York Commodity Desk, 212-859-1640))
